title: The snake's default pace is calm enough to steer comfortably
description: A fresh run moves the snake at a calm, even pace that leaves a player time to see ahead and turn, in the 3D first-person view, with no setup required.

steps.goal: On the Snake game, start a run if one is not already running. Watch the snake move for several seconds without touching anything, and judge the pace as a player would: can you follow each step and tell where the snake is heading in time to steer? If there is a first-person or 3D camera view, watch from there as the snake approaches a wall or the food.
success: The snake moved at a calm, even pace with each step clearly followable, not rushed or blurry
There was enough time between steps to decide on a turn before reaching a wall or the food
The comfortable pace was already in place from the start, with no setting or setup needed
